name: codex-autoresearch
description: Measured Codex loops with benchmark output, local evidence, live readouts, and reviewable branch previews.

interface.shortDescription: Run measured Codex loops with local evidence
interface.longDescription: Codex Autoresearch gives Codex one guided workflow for bounded measured loops: define the goal and scope, validate benchmark output, keep local evidence, resume context across sessions, inspect progress in a read-only live readout, and preview reviewable branches after user approval.
defaultPrompt: @Codex Autoresearch plan a measured loop from this prompt.
@Codex Autoresearch serve the live dashboard when useful.
